title: Autonomous Video Generation for Self-Evolving World Models
abstract: arXiv:2606.24152v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly described as world models because they can learn rich spatiotemporal regularities from visual data. We argue that an ideal world model should benefit in a self-evolving generative character. As such, a self-evolving world model can be realized via a generative model conditioned by various constraints, whose future predictions are refined through feedback. However, traditional visually plausible predictions alone are not enough to establish whether an imagined future is physically actionable for a particular embodied agent, failing to provide informative feedback from environments for self-evolving improvement. translated_title: 面向自进化世界模型的自主视频生成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.24152v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：大规模视频生成模型正日益被称为世界模型，因为它们能够从视觉数据中学习丰富的时空规律。我们认为，理想的世界模型应具备自进化的生成特性。据此，自进化世界模型可以通过一个由多种约束条件化的生成模型来实现，其未来预测通过反馈不断得到精炼。然而，仅有传统的视觉上合理的预测，并不足以判断所想象的未来对于特定具身智能体是否在物理上可执行，从而无法从环境中获取有信息量的反馈以实现自进化改进。为实现自进化世界模型，本文提出了自主视频生成的概念，并通过反事实可控性对其进行评估，即：i) 生成以干预为条件的未来场景，ii) 将这些未来帧绑定到具身……
tldr: 本文提出“自主视频生成”概念，以反事实可控性（生成干预条件下的未来并将其绑定到具身智能体）作为评估标准，使视频生成世界模型能够通过环境反馈实现自进化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the concept of autonomous video generation, evaluated through counterfactual controllability—the ability to generate intervention-conditioned futures and bind them to embodied agents—enabling video-generation world models to self-evolve through informative environmental feedback.
